public_note: Noether Paper 34 GDZ/EuDML source-witness acquisition for printed pp.641-692. Source/provenance support only: not corrected TeX, not dense-math certification, not a critical edition, and not multilingual propagation.

files.coverage: Noether Paper 34, `Hyperkomplexe Größen und Darstellungstheorie`, `Mathematische Zeitschrift` 30 (1929), printed pp.641-692. The package includes GDZ/EuDML metadata, the GDZ IIIF manifest for volume `PPN266833020_0030`, a printed-page-to-canvas map for pp.641-692 / canvases 00000645-00000696, one full-resolution GDZ JPEG per printed page, a convenience source-witness PDF assembled from those images, image-dimension metadata, README, and checksums.
files.findings: The package README says this source-witness acquisition should replace the weaker local three-part `p34a_scan.pdf`, `p34b_scan.pdf`, and `p34c_scan.pdf` slices as the source-navigation witness for Paper 34. The GDZ images report about 400 ppi / roughly 2080-2208 by 3312-3344 pixels, stronger than the older 360 ppi embedded-image slices.
files.limitations: Source/provenance support only. The source is below the project's 650 dpi crop-certification rule, so it should not be treated as dense-math certification. It contains no corrected TeX branch, no translation, no full Paper 34 certification, no critical-edition claim, and no multilingual propagation. If a higher-resolution Springer/institutional scan is found, prefer it for dense matrix/table/formula micro-audit.
